out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: OBSERVED A HAND SINK IN CATERING KITCHEN IS DEFECTIVE.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE HAND SINKS AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: LOW TEMPERATURE DISHWASHER WAS OBSERVED A SANITIZING RINSE CONCENTRATION OF LESS THAN 50PPM CHLORINE SOLUTION.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. DISHWASHER WILL BE USED TO WASH AND RISE ALL FOOD CONTACT SURFACES. A PREP SINK WILL BE USED TO SANITIZE ALL FOOD CONTACT SURFACES.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: WHEN TESTED, LOW TEMPERATURE DISHWASHER WAS OBSERVED WITH A SANITIZING RINSE CONCENTRATION OF LESS THAN 50PPM CHLORINE SOLUTION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE DISHWASHER AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
